scholarships.title: Scholarship Opportunities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Study in Saudi — Ghana allocation)
scholarships.official_source: Government of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, announced by the Ghana Scholarships Authority (Republic of Ghana)

existing.description: Scholarship awards at six selected Saudi universities — Taif, Madinah, Jazan, Najran, Tabuk and Fahad Bin Sultan University — announced by the Ghana Scholarships Authority and applied for through the Saudi Ministry of Education's Study in Saudi platform. The call is open to Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who hold a genuine birth certificate and a passport, and covers programmes in technology management, business management, Islamic economics, marketing, engineering, technology, medicine, education and architecture. Applications close on 28 October 2026.
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to candidates who satisfy three published conditions: they must be Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana, hold a genuine birth certificate, and hold a passport. The notice does not state a minimum grade, degree level or language requirement.
coverage: Scholarship awards at six selected universities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia: University of Taif, University of Madinah, University of Jazan, University of Najran, University of Tabuk and Fahad Bin Sultan University
requirements: Review the eligibility requirements, terms and conditions on the official Study in Saudi platform before applying
Apply through the official Study in Saudi application portal at https://studyinsaudi.sa/en
documents: Any further documents required by the participating Saudi university on the Study in Saudi platform
application_method: Visit https://studyinsaudi.sa/en and complete the official application
Carefully review the eligibility requirements, terms and conditions before submitting
existing.selection_notes: The notice is signed by the Director-General of the Ghana Scholarships Authority and directs applicants to the Saudi Ministry's own Study in Saudi platform for the actual application.
existing.best_fit: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana with a valid passport and birth certificate who want to study in Saudi Arabia at one of the six listed universities.
existing.notes: The notice lists nine available programmes (Technology Management, Business Management, Islamic Economics, Marketing, Engineering, Technology, Medicine, Education and Architecture) but does not state whether each is a bachelor's, master's or other level, so the degree level is recorded as not specified. No monetary value or benefits are published on the notice.
existing.application_period: Notice published 28 September 2026; applications close on 28 October 2026.
